metaTitle: Custom Full Color Phone Wallets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color phone wallets with your logo. Perfect for trade shows and giveaways. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Full color phone wallets let you reproduce your logo, photos, or complex artwork with sharp detail and vibrant hues. Unlike single- or two-color imprints, full color gives you the flexibility to match brand gradients or use photographic imagery. The PopSockets PopWallet Plus, for example, sticks securely to most phone cases and holds cards or cash. These are ideal for trade show giveaways, employee welcome kits, or customer appreciation gifts where you want maximum brand impact without sacrificing utility.
